Updated review after 1.0 release:

OMG, this game dev does such a wonderful job with updates! The 1.0 release was polished so well! Sure, there are still a few small bugs and inconveniences here and there, and there was a hard reset on account progress (most of the reset was later fixed as an optional recovery), but wow. This is how you do early access, people.

I really love everything about this game, from the mechanics to the soundtrack to the motion comic cutscenes to the progression system. It's a ton of fun. Unfortunately, it's also flawed in many ways which could potentially kill your interest in long term progression:

1. The levels are small with very  little to explore.
1.a. The levels are small, but there are a lot of them, and the small levels mean a lot of agility and finesse is necessary to remain undamaged. You can't just run away all the time in this game.
1.b. There's still exploration in the beginning, but eventually, you'll probably run out of things to find since most of the game is the same layout every playthrough.

2. The game is only 2-player.
2.a. At least it's not just 1-player.
2.b. It's 2-player for a reason. If more people joined in, it'd be incredibly easy, too easy to consider a challenge, ruining most of the game's fun.

Overall, it's just an amazing game. Fun but somewhat repetitive. Priced well for its value.

Original EA review:

An amazing roguelite FPS with a ton of replayability and a ton of challenging boss fights as well as challenges between them with lots of interesting weapons and upgrades! 4 character classes as well to add some variety when playing 2-player!

Now, there are always problems. The first problem is upgrades are way too easy to max out, even with it being a beta. That plays into problem #2: you might lose your progress with each update. The game has changed a ton over the course of its early access life, and I think I've lost progress only 2-3 times, but it's still worth noting.

Overall, amazing game! I love it.
Its a very good fast paced roguelite/like exprience
